title: Tuple restriction beta compatibility
statement: For g,U,V,hinter,I,J,α,hα as in the augmented additive Cech transfer problem, let t be a total cochain map satisfying IsAdditiveCechPullbackTotalMap: on every (p,q) total summand t equals the explicitly constructed tuple section transfer [lem-pbc-etale-additive-cech-pullback-total-map]. Then in each degree n, unit-module Cech cochains x and x′ with structural pullback coordinates [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change] satisfy t.f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) = additiveCechBeta V J n x′ [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization,def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction]. The hypothesis on the action of t is essential.

proof.text: Use the total summand specification in bidegree (n,0) and unfold beta. Project the product to a tuple. Evaluate hα at the source tuple open and use naturality of J.ι along the explicit tuple pullback map to rewrite this coordinate as J.ι applied to structural pullback of the source function. Naturality of restrictFunctorΓ.inv identifies the transported function with restriction along hinter of unitToPushforwardObjUnit. The supplied coordinate equality identifies it with the function obtained from x′. ULift and J.ι preserve this equality. Product projection extensionality and then total inclusion give the result. Empty families and empty opens obey the same equalities; degree zero uses (0,0).

theorem additiveCech_pullback_total_beta
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hinter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι),
      (⨅ l, V (y l)) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (J : InjectiveResolution Y.etaleAdditiveSheaf)
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 = Scheme.etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g ≫
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (n : ℕ) (t : additiveCechTotal U I ⟶ additiveCechTotal V J)
    (ht : IsAdditiveCechPullbackTotalMap g U V hinter I J α t) :
    ∀ (x : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).X n)
      (x' : (cechOver Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).X n),
      (∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
        cechCoordinate Y.toSpecΓ V (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) n y x' =
          (show Y.Modules from SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (hinter n y)).op
            ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app
              (op (⨅ l, U (y l)))
              (cechCoordinate X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) n y x))) →
      t.f n (additiveCechBeta U I n x) = additiveCechBeta V J n x'
